I will keep the land in the usual Quzhou pattern: winter wheat followed by summer maize on the same fields. I would not split into cash crops this year. Quzhou is a typical North China Plain wheat-maize area, with most land already under that rotation, summer rain fitting maize, and irrigation mainly needed for wheat, so this is the safest way for me to hold yield and cash flow on ordinary family-managed land. On April 16, 2026, the winter wheat is already in the field, so my job now is to finish the wheat well, harvest in June, and then direct-seed summer maize right into the stubble. For fertilizer, I would stay near the middle of the official guidance ranges instead of pushing the top end, because this area already has a history of overusing nitrogen. For water, I would save irrigation for wheat’s key stages and keep maize mostly rainfed, with one emergency irrigation only if the seedbed is too dry after wheat harvest. For plant protection, I would keep it simple: two sprays on wheat around spring disease and insects plus grain filling, and one “one-spray, multiple-effects” pass on maize in the middle to late season unless pressure clearly rises. My main goal is steady grain, lower water risk, and manageable cost, not chasing a record yield. Sources I used: China Agricultural University on Quzhou’s wheat-maize system and local conditions ([PMC summary](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5290742/), [Quzhou Experimental Station](https://qzsyz.cau.edu.cn/art/2021/12/31/art_46290_874256.html)); Ministry of Agriculture fertilizer guidance for North China winter wheat and Huang-Huai-Hai summer maize ([winter wheat](https://www.moa.gov.cn/xw/zxfb/202209/t20220922_6411293.htm), [summer maize reference range via local ag bureau repost](https://nyncj.chengde.gov.cn/art/2012/7/9/art_667_93731.html)); Hebei spring irrigation note for wheat ([Hebei 2026 irrigation suggestion](https://www.agri.cn/zx/xxlb/hb/202603/t20260309_8817365.htm)); and maize mid-late season spray guidance ([MOA 2025 “一喷多促”](https://www.moa.gov.cn/gk/nszd_1/2025n/202508/t20250809_6476360.htm)).
